annotations.text:
The signature element: every quest shows what it is worth RIGHT NOW.
×0.42 after eight identical days, ×1.25 for something never attempted.
This is the anti-plateau rule made visible — the thing the other apps in this genre don't do.

CLEAR is locked until the time is genuinely served. Elapsed time is computed server-side from the persisted start, so closing the tab changes nothing.
The only verified mechanic in the app, which is why it pays best.

Real stakes, recoverable: a debuff with a floor at 40%, an escalation counter, and a way out that requires evidence.
Nothing already earned is ever destroyed.

Same Status screen, three other themes. Hologram (page 1) is the default.
All four ship as CSS custom-property sets — semantic tokens only, no raw hex in components, so they cannot drift apart.
